claims.text: Stone-forming conditions in ADPKD (distal acidification disorders, low urine volume, aciduria): potassium citrate + ↑ PO fluids are generally the tx of choice.
claims.quote: Potassium citrate and higher oral fluid intake (to increase urinary volume) are generally the treatments of choice in stone-forming conditions associated with ADPKD, such as distal acidification disorders, low urinary volumes, and aciduria.
